Documentation of TNM staging rules

tnm_rules_docs.Rd

Internal auxiliary files used to determine cancer stage.

Source

UICC_7th edition.pdf; UICC_8th edition.pdf corroborated by nhs/*.pdf; uicc/UICC_9th edition.pdf

Details

The package stores three rule sets derived from UICC guidelines for the TNM staging system. The rules stored in these files are differentiated by cancer site (bladder, breast, colorectal, lung, oesophageal, prostate, skin), classification type (clinical, pathological, base) and classification edition (7th, 8th, unspecified). The files are:

  1. tnm_concepts.csv: contains information about the individual TNM components and their concept ids, differentiated by type and edition. There are \(393\) total concepts for \(44\) unique components:

    TX, T0, Tis, Ta, T1, T1a, T1b, T1c, T1mi, T2, T2a, T2b, T2c, T3, T3a,
T3b, T4, T4a, T4b, T4c, T4d, NX, N0, N1, N1a, N1b, N1c, N1mi, N2, N2a,
N2b, N2c, N3, N3a, N3b, N3c, M0, M1, M1a, M1b, M1c, M1c1, M1c2, M1d.

    These components have different versions according to:

    • Edition: \(131\) concepts for 7th, \(131\) for 8th, \(131\) for unspecified;

    • Type: \(132\) concepts for base, \(132\) for clinical, \(129\) for pathological (the M0 component is not valid in the pathological setting, for any of the editions).

  2. tnm_stage_mapping.csv: contains the rules to determine the cancer stage based on a combination of individual TNM components, differentiated by cancer site, type (clinical, pathological, base) and by edition (7th, 8th, 9th). Each rule refers to a specific source page of the UICC guidelines.

    The currently available rules support the following concept categories.

    For bladder cancer:

    • Edition: 7th, 8th, 9th available;

    • Type: only "base" is available, for all editions.

    For breast cancer:

    • Edition: 7th, 8th, 9th available;

    • Type: only "base" is available, for all editions.

    For colorectal cancer:

    • Edition: 7th, 8th, 9th available;

    • Type: only "base" is available, for all editions.

    For lung cancer:

    • Edition: 7th, 8th, 9th available;

    • Type: only "base" is available, for all editions.

    For oesophageal cancer:

    • For 7th edition, only "base" type is available;

    • For 8th edition, only "clinical" and "pathological" types are available but not "base".

    • For 9th edition, only "clinical" and "pathological" types are available but not "base".

    For prostate cancer:

    • For 7th edition, only "base" type is available;

    • For 8th edition, only "clinical" type is available;

    • For 9th edition, only "clinical" and "pathological" types are available but not "base".

    For skin cancer:

    • For 7th edition, only "pathological" type is available;

    • For 8th edition, only "clinical" and "pathological" types are available but not "base".

    • For 9th edition, only "clinical" and "pathological" types are available but not "base".

  3. tnm_stage_shortcut_mapping.csv: contains some more general rules to determine the cancer stage based on a subset of individual TNM components, differentiated by cancer site, type and edition. In fact, there are some special cases in which the value of one or two components is enough to determine the stage, independently of the others. Each rule refers to a specific source page of the UICC guidelines.

These files are meant for internal use and are not intended to be modified by users.
